description: Remove private defaults from Uptick, rotate private integrations, rebuild clean public history, and publish version 0.7.0.

userStories.title: Add private integration configuration
userStories.description: As an Uptick user, I want account-specific integration settings loaded only from private local configuration so that public source never contains my identifiers.
acceptanceCriteria: Add an ignored private configuration file format with the Uptick Calendar, Reminders, owner, assignee, and series-rule keys.
Calendar writes fail closed with no configured target.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Generalize optional companions
userStories.description: As a public Uptick installer, I want the calendar, task-audit, series, and priority helpers to work from generic configuration instead of the author's data.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove hardcoded account IDs and personal/work rules.
Load optional merge and skip rules from a private JSON file.
Keep unconfigured optional integrations non-mutating.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Repair public helper packaging
userStories.description: As a public Uptick installer, I want shipped wrappers and examples to be generic and executable.
acceptanceCriteria: Make the task-audit wrapper call the shipped Python helper.
Use Uptick-generic lock and log names.
Remove private examples from UI text and test fixtures.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add release privacy guardrails
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want automated public-boundary and secret checks so private defaults cannot return unnoticed.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a release-boundary regression test.
Ignore private release-audit term files.
Add GitHub Actions validation and Gitleaks scanning.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Rotate private Calendar and Reminders resources
userStories.description: As an Uptick owner, I want replacement private integration targets so publicly exposed identifiers are no longer used.
acceptanceCriteria: Create dedicated replacement Calendar and Reminders resources.
Migrate only automation-owned items and verify dry runs.
Do not retire old resources without an action-time confirmation.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create clean public history
userStories.description: As the repository owner, I want a sanitized public root history so old releases no longer expose private source content.
acceptanceCriteria: Create and verify an offline mirror backup before ref replacement.
Publish a clean root with no legacy public branches or tags.
Request GitHub removal of unreachable cached objects.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Publish and verify Uptick 0.7.0
userStories.description: As a public Uptick user, I want a verified 0.7.0 release that installs cleanly without private configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: Bump manifest and versions metadata to 0.7.0.
Pass clean-install, renderer, structure, Python, and release-boundary tests.
Publish the documented public assets and verify remote refs and release metadata.
Typecheck passes
